title: Precedent: progress
summary: The big picture without a status meeting. What each does, and what we'd borrow (the cards that borrow it are in brackets).

checks.text: Basecamp Hill Charts: Dots move uphill (unknowns) and downhill (execution); a dot that stalls is a raised hand. We borrow: movement since you last looked (What the overview shows)
Linear project updates and Pulse: On track, at risk or off track, plus a note; Pulse digests what changed. We borrow: the health note and since-you-last-looked (What the overview shows)

why: Both show movement rather than status, and both are written for the person who wasn't there, which is you between sessions.

options.label: Looks right
options.then: Keep these as the models the cards cite, and build to them.

options.label: One's wrong for us
options.sub: say which, and why, in the note
